review_evidence: README identifies hott3 as a work-in-progress Lean 3 port of the Lean 2 homotopy type theory library.
The project deliberately formalizes HoTT foundations with a univalence axiom, higher-inductive-type support, altered singleton-elimination discipline, and domain-specific proof automation.
The unit contains 73 primary Lean files of HoTT mathematics and foundations; this is independently addressable formal prior art, not repository scaffolding.
summary: Retain hott3 as a substantive Lean 3 homotopy-type-theory library with univalence, HIT support, and formal mathematics.
